service.name: SceneResource_SelectRandomActorVariant
behavior: Calls TerrainScene5RandomStep and masks the returned word with 0x78, producing one of sixteen eight-byte table indices.
Repeats when the selected type equals the current type byte of actor record 1.
Writes the selected type, paired animation-stream pointer, and clears actor byte +0x37.

table.layout: type longword followed by animation pointer longword

conclusion: The former anonymous helper is the scene-rebuild random actor-variant selector. Its weighted table, no-repeat rule, animation pairing, and transient-byte reset are now explicit; the visual identities of actor types 0x01 through 0x04 remain separate questions.
